The '''master''' of the [[wilwog]] [[Itipiniwi]] brought [[Gender/Legends|sexes]] to the [[Annual Mid-Rim Domesticated Sub-Sentient Show]]. Itipiniwi was awarded "Best in Show," which caused her owner to become excited and produce noise, which Itipiniwi imitated. The noise caused [[Boshuda]], another pet at the show, to become agitated and eat Itipiniwi.<ref name="HoloNetNews">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|life/1337_1.html|Best in Show Eaten by Second-Best}}</ref>
